questions.q: You have just sent a formal quotation. Which three things change on the deal?
o: Stage to Proposal, quoteRef filled, amountBasis to QUOTED
Stage to Customer, probability 100, closeDate today
questions.e: Proposal, the quotation number in quoteRef, and amountBasis flipped from ESTIMATED to QUOTED. Then set the chase as your next step with a date.

questions.q: You spoke to a contact who is not yet in People. Why does it matter?
o: It does not - the email is stored anyway
Their email history is stored but shows on no record until the person exists
The CRM will reject the email
It blocks the opportunity from being created
questions.e: The mail is captured, but with no matching person it attaches to nothing. Two clicks - name, email, company - and the whole thread appears on the record.

questions.q: When does the quote follow-up cadence stop on its own?
o: Never - you must always stop it manually
When the customer replies, the deal advances a stage, or it is won or lost
questions.e: It auto-stops on a reply, a stage advance, a win or a loss, or when all the steps have elapsed. You can also set Cadence Status to Stopped by hand.

questions.q: A customer rings about a delivery that has not arrived. Where does that belong?
questions.e: Winning the money is sales; delivering on the promise is Customer Operations. A delivery chase is a Case, not pipeline.
